messages:
maya: opened PR 8309 to add concise Console instrumentation examples showing trace propagation + cost/latency tagging. Added Ruby + Go snippets and a short YAML migration note (camelCase -> snake_case). Need quick review.

ted: which pages are affected so I can verify anchors?

maya: docs/console/instrumentation and docs/dashboards/row-mapping. The YAML change is `traceMeta` -> `trace_meta` and `costBuckets` -> `cost_buckets`. We'll show a compatibility block to avoid breaking existing embeds.

olga: paste snippets so I can run them through the examples runner.

maya: Ruby first:
```ruby
# Ruby (gem redwood ~>0.9)
require 'redwood'
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_KEY'])
client.attach_trace(trace_id: 'r-101', attrs: { route: '/v1/generate', model: 'redwood-2' }, cost: { tokens: 30 })
# subsequent client.generate(..., trace_context: client.current_trace)
```

maya: Go snippet:
```go
// Go (inference-go v0.4+)
ctx := context.Background()
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
ctx = redwood.WithTrace(ctx, redwood.Trace{ID: "r-101", Attrs: map[string]string{"route":"/v1/generate","model":"redwood-2"}, Cost: redwood.Cost{Tokens: 30}})
// pass ctx into client.Generate(ctx, ...)
```

patrick: small nit: the Go Cost.Tokens field is int64 in the SDK; update snippet to show an integer literal (30). Also add an SDK version note for each snippet so readers know when helpers were added.

maya: good call. I'll add a one-line "SDK note" above snippets: Ruby >=0.9; Go >=0.4.

docs-bot: link-checker: replaced obsolete anchor /docs/dashboards#old-row -> /docs/dashboards#row-mapping. Please confirm.

olga: ran snippets: Ruby required adjusting require path (gem vs lib name) which I corrected in the snippet. Go compiled locally after changing Tokens to 30 (int). I also uploaded the example dashboard screenshot and added alt text.

ted: migration note suggestion: include a compact YAML compatibility example: 
```yaml
# canonical (new)
trace_meta: { id: "r-101" }
cost_buckets: [10,50,200]
# legacy (accepted)
traceMeta: { id: "r-101" }  # deprecated
costBuckets: [10,50,200]     # deprecated
```

maya: adding that and a short FAQ line: "Will old dashboards break?" -> "No, server accepts legacy keys but logs deprecation warnings; update embeds to snake_case."

patrick: can we add a lightweight docs-ci job that yaml-parses the example file to catch regressions? Non-blocking on rollout.

maya: noted; I'll add the job in a follow-up PR and mark this one `docs: trace-prop-samples` so release tooling picks it up. Targeting merge after CI.

ted: LGTM once the minor snippet tweaks land.

olga: Verified after fixes, examples render in runner and YAML parse passes locally.

maya: Thanks all  merging after CI green. I'll add the changelog note `migration: yaml-key-names` and ping platform teams about the deprecation notice.
